name: Sony A5100
notes: First target body. Tested on firmware 3.10 with a Sigma 30mm F1.4 DC DN (tools/camera-test.sh --photos): exposure, focus, drive, and look settings were read back from the camera and compared with photo EXIF where recorded; the lens name and focal length (tenths of a mm) were read from the body. soft_skin was checked with tools/camera-test.sh --face: the low 16 bits of SoftSkinEffect matched Low on two photos; the body also set 0x10000 on the one photo with a detected face, and not on photos without one. self_timer was checked with the physical shutter button at 2 s and 10 s using single drive; turning it off restored immediate shooting and burst drive. auto_iso_range is no: setISOAutoMin/Max do not exist on firmware 3.10 (firmware report) and fail on the body.
